picks.editorial_note: Purdue landing two of the first 278 DOE Genesis Mission awards signals the university's early leadership in a flagship federal AI-for-science initiative, with direct application to accelerating discovery at facilities like the Electron-Ion Collider.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: A £20 million MRC-funded hub combining stem cell models with AI is a substantial, well-resourced bet on using machine learning to speed up and de-risk early drug development.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model for spatial tumor proteomics represents a genuine scientific advance toward AI systems that can generalize across cancer types to predict treatment response.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's use of generative AI to design entirely novel proteins, building on Nobel Prize-winning computational techniques, pushes the frontier of AI-driven molecular design with broad downstream applications.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: A Dirac Medal for foundational statistical-mechanics work underpinning modern neural network theory is a top-tier recognition that connects core AI methods to fundamental physics.
picks.title: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem Congratulates Prof. Haim Sompolinsky on Receiving the 2026 Dirac Medal

picks.editorial_note: RoboDojo's unified benchmark for embodied AI, built with nearly 20 global universities including Berkeley and Tsinghua, aims to standardize how robot manipulation reliability is measured worldwide.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: SRI's ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM system, developed with Mayo Clinic and the University of Florida, brings AI-guided medical procedures like blood draws and intubation closer to real clinical deployment.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: A University of Alabama-Fermilab DOE Genesis Mission award applying AI to particle physics data, and to securing AI systems that run the electric grid, illustrates the initiative's reach into both fundamental science and critical infrastructure.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project

picks.editorial_note: A university-born startup joining semiconductor giant AMD to optimize NPU performance for large language models shows academic AI research translating directly into industry hardware adoption.
picks.title: URI professors’ startup team joined semiconductor giant AMD

picks.editorial_note: A $12 million Army Research Laboratory grant for animal-inspired sensing in autonomous drones and robots is a significant defense investment in next-generation AI-driven field robotics.
picks.title: $12M grant to build animal-inspired sensing for autonomous drones and robots | Penn State University
